title: refactor: parse listing payloads with schemas
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Defines the proxy storage contract as a Zod schema and derives its TypeScript type
- Dispatches all stored listing payloads through one schema map
- Rejects corrupt stored rows instead of partially populating them
- Defaults fields added after the listing-envelope migration

Tests:
- Enter and Gen typechecks
- 2 focused payload parsing tests
- 6 community endpoint policy integration tests

gist.headline: The listings learned to read
gist.blurb: Community listings now pass through one proper schema gate instead of arriving assembled from whatever bits survived storage. Polli brought a clipboard; the corrupt rows did not make the guest list.
gist.summary: Community listing payloads are now validated through a centralized Zod schema map, with TypeScript types derived from the storage contract, migration-era fields defaulted, and corrupt rows rejected rather than partially populated.
gist.impact: Community endpoints now return more consistent listing data, including safe defaults for fields introduced after the listing-envelope migration.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy community-garden filing station where Polli validates seed-packet-like listing payloads through a single labeled schema gate; healthy packets become neat code-plants while a smudged corrupt packet is gently redirected away. A helpful CRT monitor robot can hold the schema map, making the idea of centralized validation and reliable defaults immediately visible.
